specializations.description: A master of the magical arts that control time. Chronomancers can alter the flow of battle when battling with a party.

specializations.name: High Cleric
specializations.description: An advanced magic user that can cast healing and defensive spells. Learns healing and holy magic.

specializations.name: Maji
specializations.description: An expert magician who conjures magic with ease. Spells cast by the Maji cost far less mana.

specializations.name: Raider
specializations.description: A formidable raider of Nothren that fights without care or self-preservation.

specializations.name: Sequencer
specializations.description: A mage that prefers a more cannon-like approach to engaging battles. Spells may occasionally be cast twice while dual-wielding magical staves.

specializations.name: Tamer
specializations.description: A true expert of nurturing beasts of the wild. Followers of a Tamer are stronger and may attack more often.

raids.name: Dracon
raids.description: Once an infamous king, Dracon led the Draconians to fulfill the Great Dragons' wishes.

raids.name: Fomor
raids.description:
Arguably, Fomor has been the least prolific of Fomorian rulers.

Appointed by a Balor king, he is a master in creating illness.

raids.name: Pumpkin Spider
raids.description: Raised from the seeds of the foul Pumpkinhead.

raids.name: Age-Old Mimic
raids.description: One of another time.

raids.name: Hel
raids.description:
With resolution
and without remorse
I will gladly
await my own.

raids.name: Ingenious Cade
raids.description: Cade, the famed inventor of Avalon, was well renowned for the esoteric gadgets he produced. Perhaps he has been working on something new?

raids.name: King of Ljosalfar
raids.description: As day fades, the nameless King of the Ljosalfar has shown himself.

raids.name: Scruug
raids.description: An apparition of greed and envy. Once a year, the dreaded Scruug returns from the Underworld with the goal to destroy all happiness.

raids.name: Starlord
raids.description: It's not often a goblin looks to the skies, but the lord known as "Starlord" could not resist celestial magic.

raids.name: Surtr
raids.description:
Surtr moves from the south.
With the scathe of branches.
There shines from his sword.
The sun of Gods of the Slain.

raids.name: Tatzelwurms
raids.description: The Tatzelwurms worked tirelessly to level Lotan's coiled rock.

raids.name: Young Apollyon
raids.description: A memory of a younger Apollyon, mystic of Balor. Before exploring such unorthodox magics, Apollyon was both a great teacher and student to Balor's native arts.

raids.name: Aries
raids.description: The forest goat Aries has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: Cerus
raids.description: The untamed bull Cerus has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: Fallen Judge Achlys
raids.description:
Achlys, the Red Dagger.
Judge of the Rift.

raids.name: Fallen Merlin
raids.description: Merlin was the most famed and powerful Sorcerer of Avalon, and his demise just may have contributed to the ultimate decay of the great Kingdom.

raids.name: Fallen Warlock Trevelyan
raids.description: It is said that Trevelyan was the last of the court of Meliodas to fall.

raids.name: Fey Gazer
raids.description: A gazer lost to the curse of Morrigan.

raids.name: Last Titan
raids.description: The Olympian titans were once revered for their might and wisdom, but have seldom been seen after the Falling.

raids.name: Perseus
raids.description: The gorgon slayer Perseus has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: Sister Neman
raids.description: A great witch of curse and plague, Neman, sister to Morrigan.

raids.name: The Fool
raids.description: Once a Fool, twice a Fool, thrice a Fool he was. Always a Fool, never a Fool, if only he knew of combat.

raids.name: Thronemaker Neith
raids.description: A Goddess of wisdom, Neith migrated to the North.

raids.name: Fallen Judge Rhada
raids.description:
Rhada, the Great Shield.
Judge of the Rift.

raids.name: Fey Dragon
raids.description: A dragon lost to the curse of Morrigan.

raids.name: First Horseman
raids.description: The first of the Four Horseman, the foul being brings famine to the land.

raids.name: Grand Knight Lugus
raids.description: A knight of Balor, Lugus calls to battle.

raids.name: Maelor
raids.description: A noble of Balor, Maelor strikes fear to many.

raids.name: Menja
raids.description:
Now are we come
to the king's house,
the prescient damsels,
Fenja and Menja.

raids.name: Naggeneen
raids.description: Oh, the foul fairy Naggeneen.

raids.name: Phoenix
raids.description: From the ashes, it has risen.

raids.name: Sapling of Yggdrasil
raids.description: Young tree born of Yggdrasil.

raids.name: Sister Badb
raids.description: A great witch of curse and plague, Badb, sister to Morrigan.

raids.name: Thronemaker Sekhmet
raids.description: A Goddess of destruction, Sekhmet migrated to the East.

raids.name: Almighty Balin
raids.description:
From Avalon comes the Knight with Two Swords.

One blade of attack, one of ward.

raids.name: Asteria of Olympia
raids.description: With great magic and great resolve, Asteria raised the floors of Olympia's towers in to place.

raids.name: Atlas of Olympia
raids.description: Rumored to have lifted a world worth of stone up to the skies, Atlas's strength could not be rivaled.

raids.name: Fallen Judge Charon
raids.description:
Charon, the Grand Summoner.
Judge of the Rift.

raids.name: Fallen King Arthus
raids.description: King Arthus of Avalon, fallen after many a battle for the Lady's will.

raids.name: Fenja
raids.description:
Now are we come
to the king's house,
the prescient damsels,
Fenja and Menja.

raids.name: Fey Cockatrice
raids.description: A cockatrice lost to the curse of Morrigan.

raids.name: Gerd
raids.description:
A maiden dear to me.
Her arms glittered, and from their gleam.
Shone all the sea and sky.

raids.name: Jormungandr
raids.description:
Around the world.
Around the world.
Around the world.
It wraps.

raids.name: Kerberos
raids.description: Arisen from the deep depths of the underworld.

raids.name: Mimic King of Kings
raids.description: A king? Of what?

raids.name: Ophion of Olympia
raids.description: Conjured to keep watch over the titans, Ophion learned much of commanding forces.

raids.name: Orochi
raids.description: Orochi, who breathed life to the diligent Tatzelwurms, was lost to Morrigan's curse.

raids.name: Pumpkinhead
raids.description: A true brute of stories of old. Some say the Hallowed should be feared more than the Fallen.

raids.name: Pumpkinless
raids.description: He has truly lost his mind.

raids.name: Rift Judgement
raids.description:
Rhada, the Great Shield.
Achlys, the Red Dagger.
Charon, the Grand Summoner.

raids.name: Second Horseman
raids.description: The second of the Four Horseman, the foul being brings pestilence to the land.

raids.name: Sister Macha
raids.description: A great witch of curse and plague, Macha, sister to Morrigan.

raids.name: Thronemaker Ptah
raids.description: A God of creation, Ptah migrated to the South.

raids.name: Aloof Aries
raids.description: The forest goat Aries has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: Apollyon
raids.description: A destructive exiled Balor mystic, Apollyon sought to destroy lands to stop the falling. He was quickly exiled for his unorthodox approaches.

raids.name: Arisen Balin
raids.description:
From Avalon comes the Knight with Two Swords.

One blade of attack, one of ward.

raids.name: Arisen Cade
raids.description: Cade, the famed inventor of Avalon, was well renowned for the esoteric gadgets he produced. Perhaps he has been working on something new?

raids.name: Arisen Merlin
raids.description: Merlin was the most famed and powerful Sorcerer of Avalon, and his demise just may have contributed to the ultimate decay of the great Kingdom. This difficult raid will garnish rewards for most player levels.

raids.name: Arisen Naggeneen
raids.description: Oh, the foul fairy Naggeneen.

raids.name: Arisen Phoenix
raids.description: From the ashes, it has risen.

raids.name: Arisen Warlock Trevelyan
raids.description: It is said that Trevelyan was the last of the court of Meliodas to fall.

raids.name: Ebon Scruug
raids.description: An apparition of greed and envy. Once a year, the dreaded Scruug returns from the Underworld with the goal to destroy all happiness.

raids.name: Ferocious Cerus
raids.description: The untamed bull Cerus has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: Fey Yeti
raids.description: A great yeti lost to the curse of Morrigan.

raids.name: Furious Cerus
raids.description: The untamed bull Cerus has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: Noble Perseus
raids.description: The gorgon slayer Perseus has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: The Fool
raids.description: Once a Fool, twice a Fool, thrice a Fool he was. Always a Fool, never a Fool, if only he knew of combat.

raids.name: The Mightiest Mimic
raids.description: Yes, it's mighty.

raids.name: Third Horseman

raids.name: Treeling of Yggdrasil
raids.description: Young tree born of Yggdrasil.

raids.name: Tricky Aries
raids.description: The forest goat Aries has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: Untarnished Perseus
raids.description: The gorgon slayer Perseus has fallen from the skies.

raids.name: Zeus
raids.description: Zeus, famed old king of Olympia. He raised an army to reach the skies.

raids.name: Arisen Asteria of Olympia
raids.description: With great magic and great resolve, Asteria raised the floors of Olympia's towers in to place.

raids.name: Arisen Atlas of Olympia
raids.description: Rumored to have lifted a world worth of stone up to the skies, Atlas's strength could not be rivaled.

raids.name: Arisen Ebon Scruug
raids.description: An apparition of greed and envy. Once a year, the dreaded Scruug returns from the Underworld with the goal to destroy all happiness.

raids.name: Arisen Fenja
raids.description:
Now are we come
to the king's house,
the prescient damsels,
Fenja and Menja.

raids.name: Arisen Gerd
raids.description:
A maiden dear to me.
Her arms glittered, and from their gleam.
Shone all the sea and sky.

raids.name: Arisen Hel
raids.description:
With resolution
and without remorse
I will gladly
await my own.

raids.name: Arisen Judge Achlys
raids.description:
Achlys, the Red Dagger.
Judge of the Rift.

raids.name: Arisen Judge Charon
raids.description:
Charon, the Grand Summoner.
Judge of the Rift.

raids.name: Arisen Judge Rhada
raids.description:
Rhada, the Great Shield.
Judge of the Rift.

raids.name: Arisen Kerberos
raids.description: Arisen (again) from the deep depths of the underworld.

raids.name: Arisen Menja
raids.description:
Now are we come
to the king's house,
the prescient damsels,
Fenja and Menja.

raids.name: Arisen Morrigan
raids.description: A great witch of curse and plague, Morrigan has been reborn more powerful than ever.

raids.name: Arisen Ophion of Olympia
raids.description: Conjured to keep watch over the titans, Ophion learned much of commanding forces.

raids.name: Arisen Pumpkinhead
raids.description: A true brute of stories of old. Some say the Hallowed should be feared more than the Fallen.

raids.name: Arisen Pumpkinless
raids.description: He has truly lost his mind.

raids.name: Arisen Quetzalcoatl
raids.description: From the high skies to the low lakes. She is reborn.

raids.name: Arisen Rift Judgement
raids.description:
Rhada, the Great Shield.
Achlys, the Red Dagger.
Charon, the Grand Summoner.

raids.name: Arisen Surtr
raids.description:
Surtr moves from the south.
With the scathe of branches.
There shines from his sword.
The sun of Gods of the Slain.

raids.name: Arisen Thronemaker Neith
raids.description: A Goddess of wisdom, Neith migrated to the North.

raids.name: Arisen Thronemaker Ptah
raids.description: A God of creation, Ptah migrated to the South.

raids.name: Arisen Thronemaker Sekhmet
raids.description: A Goddess of destruction, Sekhmet migrated to the East.

raids.name: Ashen Phoenix
raids.description: From the ashes, it again has risen.

raids.name: Beguiled Apollyon
raids.description: A memory of a younger Apollyon, mystic of Balor. Before exploring such unorthodox magics, Apollyon was both a great teacher and student to Balor's native arts.

raids.name: Cursed King Arthus
raids.description: Great King Arthus, Fallen then Cursed. He still draws his sword for the Lady's will.

raids.name: Fallen King Centaurus
raids.description: Fallen King of Lerna, Centaurus.

raids.name: Fey Chimera
raids.description: A beastly chimera lost to the curse of Morrigan.

raids.name: Fey Jormungandr
raids.description:
Around the world.
Around the world.
Around the world.
It wraps.

raids.name: Final Horseman
raids.description: The last of the Four Horseman, the foul being is the bringer of the end.

raids.name: Finesse
raids.description: Some say swords materialize in his hands, with just a thought.

raids.name: Great Anguish
raids.description: The culmination of brutal trials of countless heroes and travelers alike.

raids.name: Great Sphinx
raids.description: Old relic of Aaru.

raids.name: Hyperion
raids.description: He that walks amongst the clouds, it is Hyperion.

raids.name: Judge Trifecta Maximus
raids.description:
Rhada, the Great Shield.
Achlys, the Red Dagger.
Charon, the Grand Summoner.

raids.name: The Last Hippogriff
raids.description: The last of its kind, only the famed Ruggiero could tame such a rare beast.

raids.name: The Morrigan
raids.description:
A great witch of curse and plague, Morrigan was the only being to defeat Apollyon as he approached Lyonesse.

Be warned that this is a difficult foe and may not be suitable for the faint at heart.

raids.name: Turned King Lyncus
raids.description: The turned King of Annwn.

raids.name: Yggdrasil
raids.description: The World Tree.

quests.name: Chapter I: 993 DCE
quests.description:
It has been 11 years since the Falling corrupted this world.

Monsters and beasts of myths, stories, and legends rose from the ground to lay waste to all.

And so you start your journey forth.

quests.name: The Blacksmiths II
quests.description: As you grow stronger, so do your enemies. Upgrade your equipment at blacksmiths to ensure you can properly defend yourself.

quests.name: The Dungeons
quests.description: Many beasts and lost warriors prefer to hide in the underworld. With a key, dungeons can be entered to encounter these rarer opponents.

quests.name: Chapter II: Goblins
quests.description:
Slimes seem easy enough to vanquish, but they are the least of your problems.

It seems the stronger you get, the more powerful the foes around you.

quests.name: Chapter III: Magic
quests.description:
These beasts also know of our magic.

But how? How have they learned our secrets?

quests.name: Chapter IV: Lord of Bandits
quests.description:
Bandits and barbarians still roam the land, pillaging both human and beastkind alike.

Defeating their lords should make rid of them.

quests.name: Chapter V: Lord of Goblins
quests.description: The goblin Lord is perhaps more dangerous than any lord of bandits.

quests.name: Chapter VI: The Draconians
quests.description:
The great dragons created the Draconians in their image to combat both humankind and the Fomorians.

Ithra, the White Knight, created the Frozenguard to keep them at bay.

quests.name: Chapter VII: Mages of Draconia
quests.description: With the power of dragons, the Draconians are naturally gifted in magic.

quests.name: Chapter VIII: Lords of Draconia
quests.description:
Defeating the Draconians will not be easy.

If it were, the Frozenguard would have succeeded by now.

Making rid of their Lords should keep their invasion halted, at least.

quests.name: Chapter IX: The Arena
quests.description:
Humankind must keep the healthy sport of sparring up to fight the beasts of the falling.

Battle in the Arena to earn Souls, among other unique items.

quests.name: Chapter X: King of Lizarr
quests.description: The Lizarr are ruthless beasts of the sea, some even say they were a failed experiment of the great dragons.

quests.name: Chapter XI: The Pharaoh
quests.description: The Lost Pharaohs are decrepit beings of an age infinitely older than that of this one.

quests.name: Chapter XII: The Fomorians
quests.description:
The Fomorians were once a great, flourishing race of pale-skinned warriors and mages.

But as Balor rose, they were overridden, forced to fight for Balor and abandon their homeland.

Defeat them to weaken Balor's forces.

quests.name: Chapter XIII: The Undead Giant
quests.description:
Oh, the Undead Golem, tyrant of the restless dead.

Some say it is constructed of the unbreakable bones of fallen warriors.

quests.name: Chapter XIV: Carman's Pet
quests.description:
You've heard rumours of the great witch, Carman; one who can make you feel ill with just a thought.

She leads a reanimated army of statues, gargoyles, and the forest.

quests.name: Chapter XV: Of Dragons
quests.description:
Alas, the dragons can be seen.

These dragons - children of the Great Dragons, roam the land in search of unprepared warriors.

Defeat them to send a message.

quests.name: Chapter XVI: Reapers of Ankou
quests.description:
These reapers, the soldiers of Ankou, take their prey only in the night.

Lord Ankou was once a noble of Balor, but was exiled due to his taste for the truly occult.

Defeat his army to weaken his unholy reign.

quests.name: Chapter XVII: The Eyes of Ra
quests.description:
Gazers are said to be of Ra, the great seer of a desert land.

Defeat one to send a message.

quests.name: Chapter XVIII: Return of the Draconians
quests.description:
It seems not all Draconians were made alike.

The elite High Draconians were designed in both man and dragon's image by the mighty wyvern Tiamat.

quests.name: Chapter XIX: Hound of Balor
quests.description:
The mighty Cerberus, gatekeeper of Balor.

This hound is no friend of man.

quests.name: Chapter XX: The Great Witch
quests.description:
Not a soul really knows where Carman came from.

She traveled to this land with her three sons, animating an army of statues along the way.

The truest of warriors have never lasted an encounter with her and her vile spells.

quests.name: Chapter XXI: Tiamat
quests.description:
Tiamat, the great wyvern, is the dragon lord of the Draconians.

Often referred to as the weaker of the wyvern brothers, he makes up for his lack of strength with his intelligence and Draconian army.

Some say he himself banished Typhon to the underworld.

quests.name: Chapter XXII: Ankou
quests.description:
Lord Ankou was once a noble of Balor, but was exiled due to his taste for the truly occult.

His army of reapers pillage this land, in search of the truly decrepit.

Defeating him will surely be no easy task.

quests.name: Chapter XXIII: The Ljosalfar
quests.description:
The Ljosalfar, light elves of the bright sun, flourished after the falling.

So much so, that they banished the storied Dokkalfar to the underworld.

quests.name: Chapter XXIV: The Dokkalfar
quests.description:
The mighty Dokkalfar were once a proud race of elves.

Unfortunately, their distaste of the sun attributed to their loss to the Ljosalfar.

They are now banished to the underworld. Not a soul has seen them since.

quests.name: Chapter XXV: The Elven Lords
quests.description:
To shift the power that the Ljosalfar and Dokkalfar hold, one must defeat their mighty lords.

Though finding them may prove difficult.

quests.name: Chapter XXVI: The Army of Balor
quests.description:
Balor truly seems to have flourished after the falling.

Some say they may have attributed to it.

Annwn, the kingdom of majestics, has vowed to stop them. Will you help them in their quest?

quests.name: Chapter XXVII: Balor
quests.description: The King himself has entered this wasteland.

quests.name: Chapter XXVIII: Fallen Gods
quests.description:
Ithra, Thor, Vulcan, and Demeter. These four great lords founded the factions of today, but all have succumbed to the falling.

Putting an end to their suffering will be instrumental in restoring peace to this land.

requirements.label: Defeat Fallen Demeter, the Earth Magus
Defeat Fallen Ithra, the White Knight
Defeat Fallen Thor, the Storm God
Defeat Fallen Vulcan, the Red Knight

quests.name: Finale: Mammon
quests.description:
As the gods of old fell, each uttered the name of Mammon.

Born of humankind's sins and hubris, Mammon undoubtedly brought the Falling upon this world, bringing a realization of all fears, myths, and fables that humankind believed so clever.

quests.description: Ceres needs you to collect some items for a particular lure.

quests.name: A Fallen Hero: Part II
quests.description: Ceres needs you to collect some items for a particular lure.

quests.name: Ambush!
quests.description: Balor has returned! Catha needs you to help defeat their army. This quest includes foes of both day, night, and dungeon.

quests.name: A Fallen Hero: Part III
quests.description: Ceres needs you to collect some items for a particular lure.

quests.name: A Fallen Hero: Part IV
quests.description: You need one final collection of materials to construct the "Lover's Lost" charm.

quests.name: A Fallen Hero: Finale
quests.description: With the aid of the Lover's Lost lure, it is time to find and defeat the Fallen Hero.

quests.name: The Sixth Tier
quests.description: It is time to focus on becoming stronger.

quests.name: The Center of Town
quests.description: Gol would like to help construct a better Origin Town.

quests.name: The Jeweller and the Herbalist
quests.description: Although difficult to understand, it seems like Gol would like you to build a Herbalist and a Jeweller.

quests.name: The Citadel
quests.description: Gol would like you to further build out your Origin Town. Having a Citadel will allow your townspeople to occasionally reward your efforts with gifts.

quests.name: Town Morale
quests.description: Gol would like you to start working on your Origin Town's morale. Complete quests posted at your Town Hall to raise morale.

quests.name: The Seventh Tier
quests.description: It is time to focus on becoming stronger.

quests.name: The Arisen
quests.description: Knight Samson has informed you of a new threat: the Arisen. You are tasked to defeat a collection of them as the Unfelled learn more about this new threat.

quests.name: Arisen War!
quests.description: Knight Samson needs your help against the Arisen army.

quests.name: Raids
quests.description: Asmund believes you are ready to take on more powerful foes: Raids.

quests.name: Who are the Enlightened?
quests.description: Before meeting Emile, Knight Samson would like to see you grow stronger.

quests.name: Emile & The Enlightened
quests.description: Emile has told you of the plight of the Enlightened -- and the source of the Arisen. For now, you will need to focus on learning more about the Enlightened.

quests.name: The Crystalis
quests.description: Emile's research would receive a significant boon if you can recover the Crystalis.

quests.name: Catalysts of Royalty
quests.description: Emile's research would be greatly improved if you can retrieve these potent catalysts.

quests.name: The Eighth Tier
quests.description: It is time to focus on becoming stronger.

quests.name: Day & Night
quests.description: According to Seeker Mara, an elf named Damra is in need of Lightstone.

quests.name: The Stewards
quests.description: Damra would like to help you find your Steward. You will need materials.

quests.name: Cheating Death
quests.description: Confronting and escaping your own demise is an important part of the Steward ritual.

quests.name: A Great Hero
quests.description: The last piece of the Steward ritual is to become the best hero you can.

quests.name: The Ninth Tier
quests.description: It is time to focus on becoming stronger.

quests.name: The Towers of Olympia
quests.description: Pelops, a certain madman, asked that you enter a Tower of Olympia.

requirements.label: Ascend floors of a Tower of Olympia

quests.name: To Arms!
quests.description: Balor has invaded. Defeat their forces.

quests.name: The Masterforge
quests.description: Galar would like you to masterforge a piece of equipment. You can masterforge weapons or armor at an Alchemist after upgrading them to Level 10.

quests.name: Buarainech, Old King of Balor
quests.description: To defeat Buarainech, you must defeat each of his apparitions.

quests.name: Annwn Provisions
quests.description: Anthony has a curious list of provisions needed in the fight against Balor.

quests.name: Knight Sirus
quests.description: With both Buarainech and Knight Sirus defeated, the Balor forces will surely retreat.

quests.name: Fallen Gods
quests.description:
Ithra, Thor, Vulcan, and Demeter. These four great lords founded the factions of today, but all have succumbed to the falling.

Putting an end to their suffering will be instrumental in restoring peace to this land.

requirements.label: Defeat Fallen Demeter, the Earth Magus
Defeat Fallen Ithra, the White Knight
Defeat Fallen Thor, the Storm God
Defeat Fallen Vulcan, the Red Knight

quests.name: Mammon
quests.description:
As the gods of old fell, each uttered the name of Mammon.

Born of humankind's sins and hubris, Mammon undoubtedly brought the Falling upon this world, bringing a realization of all fears, myths, and fables that humankind believed so clever.

quests.name: The Final Tier
quests.description: It is time to focus on becoming stronger.

quests.name: Th' Demonforge
quests.description: Galar would like you to demonforge a piece of equipment. You can demonforge weapons or armor at a Demonforge after it has been first masterforged.

quests.name: Finale: Medea
quests.description:
Defeating Medea will stop the growing threat of the Arisen. However, it will do little for the state of the world and the fallen.

But every victory counts.

quests.name: Path of Wintara: Trials of the Mage, Chapter I
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing blue, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Lero under falling snow. Lero can only be defeated using magical abilities.

requirements.label: Defeat Arisen Cursed Lero of Fomoria, Lero of Fomoria, or Cursed Lero of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Wintara: Trials of the Mage, Chapter II
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing blue, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Ogmios under falling snow. Ogmios can only be defeated using magical abilities.

requirements.label: Defeat Cursed Ogmios of Fomoria, Arisen Cursed Ogmios of Fomoria, or Ogmios of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Wintara: Trials of the Mage, Chapter III
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing blue, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Imona under falling snow. Imona can only be defeated using magical abilities.

requirements.label: Defeat Arisen Cursed Imona of Fomoria, Imona of Fomoria, or Cursed Imona of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Wintara: Trials of the Mage, Chapter IV
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing blue, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Esus under falling snow. Esus can only be defeated using magical abilities.

requirements.label: Defeat Arisen Cursed Esus of Fomoria, Cursed Esus of Fomoria, or Esus of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Wintara: Trials of the Mage, Chapter V
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing blue, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Caturix under falling snow. Caturix can only be defeated using magical abilities.

requirements.label: Defeat Arisen Cursed Caturix of Fomoria, Caturix of Fomoria, or Cursed Caturix of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Nocturna: Trials of the Tamer, Chapter I
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing purple, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Artio under the veil of darkness. Artio can only be defeated by followers or summons.

requirements.label: Defeat Artio of Fomoria, Arisen Cursed Artio of Fomoria, or Cursed Artio of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Nocturna: Trials of the Tamer, Chapter II
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing purple, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Mullo under the veil of darkness. Mullo can only be defeated by followers or summons.

requirements.label: Defeat Cursed Mullo of Fomoria, Arisen Cursed Mullo of Fomoria, or Mullo of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Nocturna: Trials of the Tamer, Chapter III
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing purple, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Belenus under the veil of darkness. Belenus can only be defeated by followers or summons.

requirements.label: Defeat Cursed Belenus of Fomoria, Belenus of Fomoria, or Arisen Cursed Belenus of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Nocturna: Trials of the Tamer, Chapter IV
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing purple, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Aengus Og under the veil of darkness. Aengus Og can only be defeated by followers or summons.

requirements.label: Defeat Aengus Og of Fomoria, Arisen Cursed Aengus Og of Fomoria, or Cursed Aengus Og of Fomoria

quests.name: Path of Nocturna: Trials of the Tamer, Chapter V
quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing purple, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Atepomarus under the veil of darkness. Atepomarus can only be defeated by followers or summons.

requirements.label: Defeat Cursed Atepomarus of Fomoria, Atepomarus of Fomoria, or Arisen Cursed Atepomarus of Fomoria

quests.name: The Winter Wild Hunts
quests.description: The Monumental would like you to partake in the "Winter Wild Hunts" and look back at the events of the year. Crafting a Festive Summoning Scroll at a Monumental Guild Hall will allow you to easily summon and Raid from a currently active World Event.

quests.name: Phoenixrise
quests.description: Asherah needs you to put at end to the rituals of Phoenixrise.

quests.name: Trials of Kerberos: Trial I
quests.description: In our first trial, Eriq expects us to defeat at least five foes by exploiting their elemental weakness. This trial must be completed outside of Kingdom activities and without the help of other players in battle.

requirements.label: Win a battle by exploiting an elemental weakness

quests.name: Trials of Kerberos: Trial II
quests.description: In our second trial, Eriq expects us to defeat at least two bosses by only exploiting their elemental weaknesses. This trial must be completed outside of Kingdom activities and without the help of other players in battle.

requirements.label: Win a battle against a boss while only exploiting elemental weaknesses

quests.name: Trials of Monoceros: Trial I
quests.description: In our third trial, Eriq expects us to land 5 critical hits against our opponents. This trial must be completed outside of Kingdom activities and without the help of other players in battle.

requirements.label: Defeat enemies with a critical hit

quests.name: Trials of Monoceros: Trial II
quests.description: In our fourth trial, Eriq expects us to avoid damage against opponents of our tier. This trial must be completed outside of Kingdom activities and without the help of other players in battle.

requirements.label: Win battle of six or more rounds against foes of your tier without taking damage

quests.name: Trials of the Manticore: Trial I
quests.description: In our fifth trial, Eriq expects us to defeat bosses of our tier without the use of a weapon. This trial must be completed outside of Kingdom activities and without the help of other players in battle.

requirements.label: Win a battle against a boss of your tier without an equipped weapon

quests.name: Trials of the Manticore: Trial II
quests.description: In our sixth trial, Eriq expects us to finish a battle dungeon without the use of any armor (head, torso, and legs). This trial must be completed outside of Kingdom activities and without the help of other players in battle.

requirements.label: Finish a battle dungeon of your tier without wearing any armor

quests.name: Trials of the Manticore: Trial III
quests.description: In our seventh trial, a crazed Eriq expects us to fell a World Raid in one encounter. This trial must be completed outside of Kingdom activities and without the help of other players in battle.

requirements.label: Finish a World Raid of any tier alone in one battle

quests.name: King Lyncus's Legacy
quests.description: Crazed with power, Eriq asks us to fell Manticores.

quests.name: Sands of Aaru
quests.description:
A curious storyteller has approached us, offering us a wealth of knowledge regarding our Kingdoms, Aaru, and perhaps more.

Read the "Aaru's Secret" scroll that she has gifted you and defeat any enemy with the learned skill.

requirements.label: Finish a battle by using the "Sands of Aaru" spell

quests.name: Aaru's End
quests.description:
A curious storyteller has approached us, offering us a wealth of knowledge regarding our Kingdoms, Aaru, and perhaps more.

Gengen-Wer's grace and power enticed all three gods, bringing out their inner beasts.

quests.name: Neith, Lyonesse
quests.description:
A curious storyteller has approached us, offering us a wealth of knowledge regarding our Kingdoms, Aaru, and perhaps more.

Lyonesse flourished with Neith's nurturing. Her spells and elixirs kept them rich in health.

quests.name: Ptah, Avalon
quests.description:
A curious storyteller has approached us, offering us a wealth of knowledge regarding our Kingdoms, Aaru, and perhaps more.

Avalon, of Ptah's learning, flourished from bandits and the like.

quests.name: Sekhmet, Annwn
quests.description:
A curious storyteller has approached us, offering us a wealth of knowledge regarding our Kingdoms, Aaru, and perhaps more.

We learn that Annwn was granted access to the arcane arts by Sekhmet.

requirements.label: Defeat monsters in Monuments that belong to an active World Event

quests.name: Three Siblings
quests.description:
A curious storyteller has approached us, offering us a wealth of knowledge regarding our Kingdoms, Aaru, and perhaps more.

She requests we learn more of the three siblings.

quests.name: Beast of Aaru
quests.description:
A curious storyteller has approached us, offering us a wealth of knowledge regarding our Kingdoms, Aaru, and perhaps more.

In Aaru beliefs, when one falls with their most prized possession in hand, their souls is infinitely bound to that object.

It glows red, signifying a soul is bound.

requirements.label: Receive an item of Ornate quality at the end of a battle

quests.name: Dark Elms
quests.description:
Terra fell as its people burned Dark Elms -- the greatest of trees that naturally cleaned the Terra's air, shaded the warm, and nurtured its young wildlife.

As the Dark Elms burned, a Gloom coated the skies and Murk tainted the seas.

20 years later may not have been too late, but the Murk began to take life. And it took Terra.

To save our planet from the fate of Terra's we must fight back against the Murk and reclaim the essence of the Dark Elm.

quests.name: Light Elms
quests.description:
As the Gloom enveloped Terra and the Murk lifted, Terra tried to keep her spirits alive.

She sprouted the Light Elm from here damaged soil. A new tree, capable of growing taller, capable of housing the largest of lungs, capable of producing the richest of fruits.

But the people of Terra did not heed her call. They cut the Light Elms all the same and devoured the Grisal with no regret.

For every Dark Elm felled, two Light Elms should have taken its place. This is the process of Emerald Restoration.

quests.name: Gloomsites
quests.description:
In this event, Gloomsites can be teleported to at will. This is how we visit Gloomsites and fight the Murk. 

Our first task is to visit one, but it may take some time until another player in the world identifies a Gloomsite that needs attention.

We travel to Gloomsite's via the "Terra's Legacy" menu in our Event Hub, found in the top right corner of your screen.

quests.name: Murk
quests.description: Murk is a life born of the waste of burned Dark Elms. We can encounter is when visiting Gloomsites.

quests.name: Elm Essence
quests.description: As we defeat the Murk and give the Elm Essence back to this planet, Light Elms will sprout from the ground.

quests.name: Light Elm
quests.description:
As the Gloom enveloped Terra and the Murk lifted, Terra tried to keep her spirits alive.

She sprouted the Light Elm from here damaged soil. A new tree, capable of growing taller, capable of housing the largest of lungs, capable of producing the richest of fruits.

But the people of Terra did not heed her call. They cut the Light Elms all the same and devoured the Grisal with no regret.

For every Dark Elm felled, two Light Elms should have taken its place. This is the process of Emerald Restoration.

Emerald Restoration can be done via the "Terra's Legacy" tab of your Event Hub.

requirements.label: Consume Elm Essence to plant a Light Elm tree

quests.name: Gaia Apples
quests.description:
Gi requests 50 Gaia Apples of us.

Delivering 50 Gaia Apples to Gi will reward you with the Terra's Bracer. But, our plight does not stop with this request.

Our planet can only be saved the same fate as Terra by continuing to fight the Murk and remember the important of sustainable Food, reduction of Waste, and Restoring what we harvest.

quests.name: Broken Hearts
quests.description: By Mara's request, defeat Anteros' followers by encountering them in Dungeons or Monuments.

quests.name: Love Fixes All
quests.description:
You recovered a broken half locket in your travels. It appears to be Mara's.

With enough Broken Hearts mended, perhaps we can mend this symbol of love itself. Visit the Event Hub or Monumental Guild to craft a mended version.

quests.name: Anteros
quests.description: Mara wishes to see you defeat Anteros.

quests.name: Nurtured by Nature
quests.description:
The people of Terra neglected their planet's natural resources for decades, using approximately 1.6 Terras worth of resources per year. When the Murk and Gloom came, the Nature of Terra was too weak to fight back. Many already endangered species were lost in a moment.

Fight alongside our own critters against the Murk by visiting Gloomsites via the Event Hub.

quests.name: Riftfall
quests.description: Clarent will need Delta Achlys Riftlock Fragments. They can be found by defeating Achlys's Rift Rogues.

quests.name: Achlys, the Red Dagger
quests.description: Defeat Achlys and retrieve her Theta Achlys Riftlock.

quests.name: Riftguards
quests.description: Clarent will need Delta Rhada Riftlock Fragments. They can be found by defeating Rhada's Riftguards.

quests.name: Rhada, the Great Shield
quests.description: Defeat Rhada and retrieve the Theta Rhada Riftlock.

quests.name: Rift Summoners
quests.description: Clarent will need Delta Charon Riftlock Fragments. They can be found by defeating Charon's summoners.

quests.name: Charon, Grand Summoner
quests.description: Defeat Charon and retrieve the Theta Charon Riftlock.

quests.name: Omega Riftlock
quests.description: Clarent can combine all Riftlocks, forming the Omega Riftlock.

quests.name: A Fistful of Steel
quests.description: In quest to help Dudley forge a hammer of the ages, we must first find him some Steel.

quests.name: A Forgeful of Steel
quests.description: Dudley asks you to upgrade any item at the Blacksmith that requires Steel.

quests.name: A Fistful of Mythril
quests.description: In quest to help Dudley forge a hammer of the ages, we must find him some Mythril.

quests.name: A Forgeful of Mythril
quests.description: Dudley asks you to upgrade any item at the Blacksmith that requires Mythril.

quests.name: A Fistful of Adamantine
quests.description: In quest to help Dudley forge a hammer of the ages, we must first find him some Adamantine.

quests.name: A Forgeful of Adamantine
quests.description: Dudley asks you to upgrade any item at the Blacksmith that requires Adamantine.

quests.name: A Feast of Feathers
quests.description: Justin Beaker has asked you to hunt “turkeys” to feed the townsfolk. He seemingly has not seen a turkey before. Gather birds and return them to the Town Hall for the harvest feast.

quests.name: The Gobblefather
quests.description: Find a real Thanksgiving turkey for Owl Pacino...A bird who cannot tell other birds apart, including himself.

quests.name: Who is Ruairc?
quests.description:
We have just met Ruairc, who insists we must have known of him before. A Knight of Uineill? A coastal Kingdom, as your history book may dictate.

The cliffside of former Uineill is now home to many sea monsters. Perhaps we can learn more about them from Ruairc.

quests.name: Sister Neman
quests.description:
Today, we learn of Mori's youngest sister,  Sister Neman.

She had particular talent for making her tonics rather tasteless.

quests.name: Merrow and Selkie, Fey
quests.description: Ruairc tells us of the Merrow and Selkie, what were then the mothers and sisters of Uineill.

quests.name: Sister Badb
quests.description:
Today, we learn of Mori's next sister,  Sister Badb.

She had particular talent for making her mind-controlling substances.

quests.name: The Caoranach
quests.description:
Ruairc, modest as ever, tells us the story of his encounter with a "Caoranach", a dragon that seemingly terrorized Uineill.

You can challenge The Caoranach by using a "Caoranach's Lair Key" at any Dungeon found in the world.

quests.name: Sister Macha
quests.description:
We now learn of Sister Macha, a powerful sorceress with a strange talent.

...turning greedy men into lizards?

quests.name: Titan Oillipheist
quests.description:
The Oillipheist, the brutal evolution of Ulster's curse, lies atop a Tower of Olympia.

The may receive a key to his tower by defeating his Caoranach form.

quests.name: The Morrigan
quests.description: ♪ And she will rise and rise again, for she is The Morrigan, and she will rise and rise again. ♪

quests.name: Welcome to Orna
quests.description:
Welcome to Orna, a location-based game inspired by classic RPGs.

Let's start your journey by defeating a monster on the map.

quests.name: Level 2
quests.description: Defeat monsters to level up your character.

quests.name: Potions
quests.description: Potions can be used to recover HP and Mana in-battle or from the world map.

quests.name: Level 3
quests.description: Defeat monsters to reach Level 3 and meet Samson to begin the main story.

quests.name: Squire Samson
quests.description: Talk to Samson to begin the main story.

quests.name: The Traveler's Guild
quests.description: Reach level 10 by defeating monsters to unlock the Traveler's Guild.

quests.name: Traveler Aspects
quests.description: Equip your first Traveler Aspect in the Traveler's Guild.

requirements.label: Equip Traveler Aspects in the Traveler's Guild

quests.name: The Astraltree
quests.description: Reach level 15 to unlock the Astraltree.

quests.name: Astralseeds
quests.description: Spend an Astralseed to unlock a reward in the Astraltree.

quests.name: Tier 2
quests.description: Reach level 25 to unlock the next tier of game content.

quests.name: Of Clurichauns and Catastrophe
quests.description: Naggeneen has tasked you with disciplining his overenthusiastic Clurichauns before their reckless celebration strips the villages of Avalon bare.

quests.name: The Council of Continuous Consumption
quests.description: The Elder Clurichauns have organized a feast without end and begun warping the land with excess... Dismantle their council and restore moderation.

quests.name: The Last Course
quests.description: The High Tasters have consumed sacred relics and now threaten to devour the very balance of the world... Defeat them before the lands themselves are eaten.

quests.name: Taliesin, the Poet
quests.description:
We meet Taliesin, who is on a quest to uncover the history of Apollyon, an important part of Balor's history.

To start our journey, let's look for remnants of Apollon's past.

quests.name: Unearthing the Memories
quests.description: With the memories of Apollyon afloat, perhaps we can collect them.

quests.name: Apollyon's Pursuit of Power
quests.description: With the memories of Apollyon afloat, perhaps we can collect them.

quests.name: Unearthing the Memories II
quests.description: With the memories of Apollyon afloat, perhaps we can collect them.

quests.name: Apollyon's Madness
quests.description: With the memories of Apollyon afloat, perhaps we can collect them.

quests.name: Unearthing the Memories III
quests.description: With the memories of Apollyon afloat, perhaps we can collect them.

quests.name: The Distorted Visage of Apollyon
quests.description: With the shattered memories of Apollyon and his followers afloat, craft the Balor Mnemonic in the Event Hub or Monumental Guild.

quests.name: The Final Bloom
quests.description:
Gi has informed you of the Final Bloom, a group of cultists that believed the Murk was born to save humankind.

Let's stop them together.

requirements.label: Defeat Ember Choirist, Bloom Requiem, or Burning Chorus

quests.name: The Rainsong
quests.description: Open the Event Hub to see the current status of this Community Goal within the "Terra's Legacy: Rainsong" event. Help the community reach their goal to unlock this quest.

quests.name: The Final Bloom's Lair
quests.description: Open the "Terra's Legacy: Rainsong" event in the Event Hub. Whenever the Rainsong is active, you may travel to the Congo to enter the Final Bloom Lair dungeon.

requirements.label: Complete a Final Bloom Lair Dungeon

quests.name: The Monument of the Murk
quests.description: Open the "Terra's Legacy: Rainsong" event in the Event Hub. Whenever the Rainsong is active, you may travel to Maluku Island to enter the Monument of the Murk.

requirements.label: Complete a Monument of the Murk

quests.name: The Rainforest Destroyer
quests.description: Open the "Terra's Legacy: Rainsong" event in the Event Hub. Whenever the Rainsong is active, you may travel to the Amazon to challenge the Rainforest Destroyer Murk raid.

quests.name: The Beasts of Avalon
quests.description: We've met Guinevere, the former Queen of the great kingdom of Avalon. She's informed us that Avalon's beasts have succumbed to the Falling.

quests.name: What Remains of the Lake
quests.description:
If we collect enough Memories of the King from those of Avalon who fell, perhaps we can find part of the lake.

The Vial of Lakewater can be crafted in the Event Hub.

quests.name: Knights of the Round Table
quests.description: Deep in the Lake, we may find what remains of four great knights.

requirements.label: Defeat Fallen Lancelot, Cursed Dagonet, Cursed Severause, Fallen Severause, Cursed Brunor, Fallen Dagonet, Cursed Lancelot, or Fallen Brunor

quests.name: Cade
quests.description: Help free Cade of his fate.

quests.name: Merlin
quests.description: Help free Merlin of his fate.

requirements.label: Complete Raid: Fallen Merlin or Arisen Merlin

quests.name: Knights of Strength
quests.description: Help free Balin and Finesse of their fate.

requirements.label: Complete Raid: Almighty Balin, Arisen Balin, or Finesse

rewards.label: Title: Knight of the Round Table

quests.name: The Last Hippogriff
quests.description: Help free Ruggiero of his fate.

quests.name: The Cursed King
quests.description: Help free Arthus of his fate.

requirements.label: Find: Crest of a Cursed King

quests.name: The Hallowed: Part I
quests.description:
A strange creature, named Feralia, wants you to find a piece of aged oak. You have no idea why.

Look for a curious creature in any Battle Dungeon.

quests.name: The Hallowed: Part II
quests.description:
A strange creature, named Feralia, wants you to find rotten leaves. You have no idea why.

Look for a curious creature wandering the world.

quests.name: The Hallowed: Part III
quests.description:
A strange creature, named Feralia, wants you to find some refined sugar. You still have no idea why.

Look for a curious creature in any Battle Dungeon.

quests.name: The Hallowed: Part IV
quests.description:
A strange creature, named Feralia, wants you to find a tattered clothwrap. You still have no idea why.

Look for a curious creature in a Great Monument.

quests.name: The Hallowed: Part V
quests.description:
A strange creature, named Feralia, wants you to find some chiroptera remains. You still have no idea why.

Look for a curious creature who wanders the world at night.

quests.name: The Hallowed: Part VI
quests.description:
A strange creature, named Feralia, wants you to find a fragment of the planet's core.

Look for a curious creature in a Great Monument.

requirements.label: Find: Fragment of the Planet's Core

quests.name: The Hallowed: Part VII
quests.description: With all materials found, Feralia can produce a replica of the Hallowed Blade.

requirements.label: Acquire Fragment of the Planet's Core

quests.name: The Hallowed: Part VIII
quests.description: With a fake Hallowed Blade, and enough Old Hallowed Blades, supposedly Feralia can make something great.

quests.name: The Seedhusk of Yggdrasil
quests.description: The Nothren Storyteller speaks of Yggdrasil, the great tree of life and death that counterbalances Ragnarok. To grasp its power, seek out the Seedhusk of Yggdrasil, guarded by the three Norns.

requirements.label: Enter a Seedhusk of Yggdrasil Dungeon

quests.name: The Seeds of Yggdrasil
quests.description: To claim a Seed of Yggdrasil, defeat the three Norns guarding the Seedhusk and break open the living wood. Complete a Seedhusk of Yggdrasil dungeon.

requirements.label: Complete a Seedhusk of Yggdrasil Dungeon

quests.name: The Power of Yggdrasil
quests.description: With a Seed of Yggdrasil in hand, awaken its full strength in the Event Hub. Unlock the Power of Yggdrasil to stand against the gods.

quests.name: Heinzelmann and the Deepgolems
quests.description: Heinzelmann, one of the last of the Deepgolems, doesn't trust that you can assemble Deepshards. Deepshards can apparently be refined within Exploration Dungeons such as a Goblin Fortress.

quests.name: The Spelunking Guild
quests.description: Upon building a Spelunking Guild, Heinzelmann can begin reassembling his friends and family using Deepshards found.

quests.name: The Dark Rift
quests.description:
Trelanc has told us of Zagreus, locked away in the depths of the Dark Rift.

We will need a key to open a door to these depths. This key can be crafted using Riftlocks in the Event Hub or Monumental Guild.

quests.name: Zagreus
quests.description: Trelanc has told us of Zagreus, locked away in the depths of the Dark Rift.

quests.name: Judge Trifecta I
quests.description: To meet the Judge Trifecta Maximus, we must craft the correct scroll in the Event Hub or Monumental Guild.

requirements.label: Find: Scroll of the Judges Trifecta

quests.name: Judge Trifecta II
quests.description: Challenge and defeat the Judge Trifecta Maximus using the scroll that you have crafted.

quests.name: Judge Trifecta III
quests.description: Challenge and defeat the Judge Trifecta Maximus using the scroll that you have crafted. Again. And again.

quests.name: The Giants
quests.description: Kaari will teach you of the Celestral Stardrop if you can fetch one from her fallen brothers and sisters.

quests.name: Memories of Giants
quests.description: Pythia believes she can make something of these Celestial Stardrops.

quests.name: The Titans
quests.description: Kaari believes you can summon a Titan with a Celestial Moondrop.

quests.name: Memories of Titans
quests.description: Pythia believes she can make something of these Celestial Moondrops.

quests.description: A strange epitaph, glowing red, begins to recall the tales of Fomoria. Our current task is to find a projection of Eostre in the sunlight. Eostre can only be defeated using physical might.

requirements.label: Defeat Cursed Eostre of Fomoria, Arisen Cursed Eostre of Fomoria, or Eostre of Fomoria

quests.name: The Red Chloris Grows
quests.description: Lerna's traitors farm the Red Chloris at this time of year. It is the nature of the Festival to stop their pursuit of Celestial power.

quests.name: Aries
quests.description: Seekers of Aries' power roam the lands. As your duty to the Festival, cut them down.

requirements.label: Defeat Aries Apostle, Aries Zealot, Aries Disciple, or Aries Acolyte

quests.name: Perseus
quests.description: Seekers of Perseus' power roam the lands. As your duty to the Festival, cut them down.

quests.description: You will find the traitors more on a descent to chaos.

quests.description: You will find the traitors more on a greater descent to chaos.

requirements.label: Craft and use a Scroll of Crimson Chaos

quests.name: Essences of Gods
quests.description: To meet the Gods themselves, we will need to collect their essence.

quests.name: The Crimson Scrolls
quests.description: At the Monumental Guild Hall or the Event Hub, we can use the essence that we find to craft Crimson Summoning Scrolls.

quests.name: Surtr, the Wanderer
quests.description: Of Nothren legend, Surtr holds a Rune meant for a ritual that brings Jormungandr to this Realm. Find him alongside your Kingdom of warriors.

items.description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

items.name: Haunted Calling Bell
items.description:
So when the winds grow sharp and thin,
And night pulls tighter round your skin,
Take heed, take care, and hush your breath,
For Dullahan rides the roads of death.

items.name: Haunted Dullahan Bladed Boots
items.description:
He bows with grace, though crownless still,
A jester bound to fate's dark will.
He tips his skull with courtly cheer,
And whispers names for none to hear.

items.name: Haunted Dullahan Cloak
items.description:
Through misty moors the rider flies,
With hollow laugh and lantern eyes.
His severed head held firm and tight,
A beacon grim in candlelight.

items.name: Haunted Dullahan Skull
items.description:
The Dullahan rides when the moon is high,
A headless shadow against the sky.
He hums a tune both sharp and sweet,
That chills the heart with every beat.

items.name: Heretic's Jewel
items.description: An adornment of the blasphemous. When adorned upon a weapon, it grants the chance to inflict damage to an opponent's magical resistance.

items.description: Footwear of a worshipper of the mighty Phoenix.

items.description: A decorated flute often used to lull the great Phoenix. Although it seemingly has little power, it is well suited for adornment.

items.description: Ivory robe of Horus, the winged protector of the skies. What it lacks in defensive power is made up with dexterity.

items.name: Huge Empty Bottle
items.description: A large bottle suitable for holding a brewed potion, tonic, or elixir. Visit a herbalist to fill this bottle.

items.name: Hydra Staff
items.description: Archistaff forged of the remains of a great Hydra. It can provide one with various elemental resistances.

items.description: A small adornment of Balor capable of increasing the dexterity and Ward of a piece of equipment when adorned upon it.

items.name: Lady of the Lake
items.description: A relic of Merlin's eccentric collection, this sword grants increased stats at the expense of attack power.

items.name: Lugus Gauntlet
items.description: Gauntlet of the Balor knight Lugus. Wearing it will provide a chance to greatly increase your offensive power.

items.name: Mighty Fishing Line
items.description: A very strong fishing line, suitable for fetching aught from the seas. Use when near a body of water or fountain to begin fishing.

items.name: Naggeneen's Belt
items.description: Belt of the mischievous clurichaun, Naggeneen. It will slightly protect one from status effects while making it easier to apply status effects to your opponents.
traits: Status Effect Chance: +20% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

items.name: Naggeneen's Hat
items.description: Headwear of the mischievous clurichaun, Naggeneen. It protects its wearer from both poison and toxicity.

items.name: Naggeneen's Song
items.description: Unkept instrument carried by the filthy Naggeneen.

items.description: A pale blade often used by the most elite of Balor knights.

items.name: Pure Darkstone
items.description: Pure darkstone. Useful for upgrading extremely dark weapons.

items.name: Ra's Cane
items.description: The trusty cane of Ra, the seer. Ra was obsessed with the senses of humans after losing much of his own. This staff increases your ability to see, while potentially blinding your opponent.

items.name: Reaper's Robe
items.description: The blackened robe of Ankou, the henchman of Death. Slightly increases orns earned. It is most fitting for the most skilled of mages.

items.name: Riftguard Armor
items.description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Rhada. When taking Ward damage while wearing this armor, one will take reduced self damage from status effects.

items.name: Riftguard Helmet
items.description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Rhada. When taking Ward damage while wearing this armor, HP and Mana will be recovered by a percentage of the Ward damage taken.

items.name: Riftguard Leggings
items.description: A piece of Judge's attire worn by Rhada. When taking Ward damage while wearing this armor, HP and Mana will be recovered by a percentage of the Ward damage taken.

items.name: Ring of Annwn
items.description: A ring of Annwn royalty. Its arcane enchantment grants the immunity to element status conditions.

items.name: Rosa's Brooch
items.description: Lunar Catalyst of Rosa, fallen queen of the Enlightened.

items.name: Satis
items.description: Bow of Thronemaker Sekhmet. When holding this weapon, one will often be granted temporary dexterity or critical strike chance in battle.

items.name: Scroll of the Sapling
items.description: A scroll consisting of the lore of the great Yggdrasil's saplings. Read this scroll to summon a Sapling of Yggdrasil to your location.
items.summon_note: Only raids at or below your tier can be summoned.

items.name: Serpent Pearl
items.description:
Charm of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

While holding this item, some your Defense and Resistance stats will be swapped. The better the quality of this item, the bigger amount of your Defense and Resistance stats will be exchanged.

items.name: Shadow Boots
items.description: Dark armor of elite Balor rogues.

items.name: Shadow Garb
items.description: Dark armor of elite Balor rogues.

items.name: Shadow Hood
items.description: Dark armor of elite Balor rogues.

items.name: Shadow Katana
items.description: A thin, pale blade granted to elite Balor warriors.

items.name: Silver Medal
items.description: Medal awarded in the Sumner Games, a storied event of Olympia.

items.name: Smelly Mushroom
items.description: A mushroom of Naggeneen's collection. Eating it will cause one to enrage, but become afflicted with Toxic.

items.name: Solar Secrets
items.description: A scroll of destructive solar magic crafted by Emile. Using it will grant the skills "Solarstrikes" and "Solarseals".

items.name: Songbook of Nature
items.description: Old Grimoire of Terra, allowing one to summon Terra's beasts.

items.name: Sour Mushroom
items.description: A mushroom of Naggeneen's collection. Eating it will greatly increase one's attack and magic powers, but become afflicted with a variety of illnesses.

items.name: Spelunking Staff
items.description: Staff of a lost dungeon explorer. It seems to have developed quite some power while resting deep within the land.

items.name: Spinal Whip
items.description:
He lifts his head as though to bow,
And tips it gently, here and now.
No crown of gold, no jeweled delight,
Just grinning teeth in ghostly white.

items.name: Spore
items.description: A spore of a toxic mushroom. Adorning it upon a weapon can add a variety of status effects to your attacks.

items.name: Staff of Tiamat
items.description: A superb staff forged of the remains of Tiamat, the great ancient dragon.

items.name: Staff of Typhon
items.description: A superb staff forged of the remains of Typhon, the great ancient dragon.

items.name: Staff of Zaltys
items.description: Chapter V: Zaltys never did like the Agathodaemon, but understood that she needed the soil for life. Zaltys laid seed to the soil, sprouting the foliage that lets us breath our air. Her staff represents life, and will allow you to recover HP each turn in battle.

items.name: Stilettos
items.description: A pair of unnecessarily sharp daggers. These will easily cause an opponent to bleed.

items.name: Symbol of Famine
items.description: Adornment of the First Horseman. Adorning it upon a piece of armor will slightly protect one from status ailments.

items.name: Timeless Pendant
items.description: A magical pendant utilized by Chronomancers. It prevents its wearer from becoming frozen in time.

items.name: Treecutter
items.description: An enormous tool carried by Gymir, a great giant. Its ability can grant one Gymir's stance, granting one additional attack power but harming oneself every turn.

items.name: Tundric Katana
items.description: A highly decorative weapon wielded by Elven warriors of the North. It boasts extra adornment slots.

items.name: Ulster's Axe
items.description: Axe of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

items.name: Ulster's Crown
items.description:
Crown of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

The crown greatly reduces the time one will be afflicted with a negative status effect. It was a shame he was not wearing it when sampling that fated wine.

items.name: Ulster's Epee
items.description: Straight sword of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

items.name: Ulster's Sceptre
items.description:
Sceptre of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

This staff will fill one Manaflask for each enemy defeated.

items.name: Vandal's Veil
items.description: A thick piece of fabric, often used to protect one's lungs. Wearing it makes one less likely to be afflicted with status effects.

items.name: Verrick's Ring
items.description: Lunar Catalyst of Verrick, fallen king of the Enlightened.

items.name: Whispered Riddle Aspect
items.description: When awakened, this Aspect will summon a Dullahan Den to your location for 12 hours. Aspects can be charged simply by walking after being slotted in your Traveler's Guild menu.

items.name: Wolfbane
items.description: A magical blade representing the unrelenting force of Fenrir the wolf. It can temporarily decrease your opponent's defense upon use. Additionally, it increases the chance of dealing collateral damage.

items.name: X Elixir
items.description: Recovers 5000 health points and 5000 mana.

items.name: X Health Potion
items.description: Recovers 5000 health points.

items.name: X Mana Potion
items.description: Recovers 5000 mana.

items.description: Light armor, reminiscent of an Olympian rogue. Zeus personally trained thousands of warriors of all tiers, perfecting an art of combat that allowed one to find additional favor in battle while protecting one's own prowess.

items.description: Armor of Thronemaker Ptah.

items.name: Aaru Robe
items.description: Armor of Thronemaker Ptah. It will grant your follower or summons the ability to use the skill "Great Meditation".

items.name: Aaru Skirt
items.description: Armor of Thronemaker Ptah. When wearing this skirt, one will often be granted temporary defense or resistance in battle.

items.name: Amadan's Staff
items.description: A small weapon carried by a Clurichaun. Although it is not suitable for your primary hand, it will fit as an obscure off-hand.

items.name: Anguished Pathspur
items.description: An item capable of reversing decisions made in anguish. Use it at the Circle of Anguish to change Anguish path level choices that you have previously chosen.

items.name: Annwn Shotel
items.description: A unique curved blade, specifically designed for escaping an opponent's defenses.

items.name: Arcane Wand
items.description: Arcane wand of Annwn court wizards. Arcane magic was found to be particularly effective against the forces of Balor.

items.name: Arisen Bone Shield
items.description: A shield made of hardened monster bone.

items.name: Arisen Bonecrusher
items.description: A terribly frightening axe, seemingly forged with the hardened bones of an undead. It has a great chance of stunning an opponent. Additionally, it increases collateral damage dealt.

items.name: Arisen Bow of Scales
items.description: Although the Lizarr seemed untrained in advanced weaponry, these fine bows have been found within their settlements. This bow is enchanted with the power of ice and water.

items.name: Atgeir
items.description: A deadly polearm carried by the fallen Heimdall, a lord of the Nothren.

items.name: Avalon Crown
items.description: The fabled crown of King Arthus. Although it offers little in terms of defense, it can protect its wearer from being cursed or petrified.

items.name: Avalon Knight Armor
items.description: Heavy armor of prestigious Avalon knights.

items.name: Avalon Knight Helmet
items.description: Heavy armor of prestigious Avalon knights.

items.description: Heavy armor of prestigious Avalon knights.

items.name: Avalon Melody
items.description: Famed golden flute of an Avalon bard. Playing its songs can temporarily raise one's magical defense.

items.name: Avalon Ore
items.description: A mighty alloy. It was used to craft Avalonian weapons and armor.

items.name: Azure Pinion
items.description: A feather pulled from the remains of a cursed Cockatrice. It grants additional magic power at the expense of magical resistance and mana.

items.name: Balanced Epee
items.description: The blademaster Finesse is known for carrying an inhuman amount of swords upon his back. This epee is one of them.

items.name: Baldur
items.description: A chunk of Baldur, favored by the raiders of Nothren.

items.name: Basilisk Talons
items.description: A pair of dark kunai, forged of a basilisk's claws.

items.name: Beag's Lute
items.description: A small weapon carried by a Clurichaun. Although it is not suitable for your primary hand, it will fit as an obscure off-hand.

items.name: Bedsheet
items.description: A simple white sheet that one could use to mock a spirit. It protects one from falling asleep in battle.

items.name: Beithir's Staff
items.description: Aside: As Illuyanka's walls were raised, protection for this new land was needed. Beithir, with the breath of lightning and claws of toxin, replicated itself indefinitely. An army of Dragons was created in an instant.

items.name: Bloodwarg Grimoire
items.description: Book carried by Fenja, the Nothren summoner. It can call a famed Nothren wolf into battle.

items.name: Book of Darkness X
items.description: A book carried by a Student of Apollyon. Before being beguiled with destructive magics, Apollyon studied the elven ways of elemental balance. These books contain great elemental affinity.

items.name: Broceliande Candle
items.description: A candle crafted by the Monumental Guild. By lighting it, you may summon a new follower.

items.name: Celestial Moondrop
items.description: A celestial essence fallen from the skies above. Consuming it will recollect stories of the Giants and Titans, summoning a Titan to your area.

items.name: Cliffside Cuirass
items.description: Chapter VI: Illuyanka then raised walls of stone to frame this new land from the raging seas and winds. The cliffs and shores can be seen from afar, and her mighty armor will surely make one feel as they are made of the cliffs themselves. It will occasionally protect you from hits that take 100% of your maximum HP.
traits: Damage Protect: 100% Max HP Damage (15% chance)

items.name: Cockatrice Mail
items.description: Chestplate forged of the remains of a mighty Cockatrice. It grants its wearer immunity from petrification.

items.name: Colada
items.description: A greatsword often used in offensive swordplay by the almighty knight, Balin. Strikes of the sword have the ability to lower an opponent's physical or magical prowess.

items.name: Coral Armor
items.description: Armor of coral, fetched from the high seas. It boasts great resistance at the sacrifice of physical defenses.

items.description: Armor of Covyn, the evil northern organizer of pixels.

items.description: A hooked blade used by Avalon assassins. Some say the great King Arthus had a secretive hobby.

items.description: An easily recognizable shield depicting the crest of Avalon.

items.description: A feather pulled from the remains of a cursed Cockatrice. It grants additional attack power at the expense of physical defense and mana.

items.name: Crooked Shotel
items.description: The blademaster Finesse is known for carrying an inhuman amount of swords upon his back. This crooked shotel is one of them. Shotels are designed to reach around an enemy's shield, thus this weapon will do additional damage to one's Ward.

items.name: Cursed Aengus Og's Lute
items.description: Second lute of Aengus Og, famous Bard of the Fomorian house of Nocturna. Aengus Og sang tales of Fomoria's conquests, but was quick to flee the lands when the great curse took haste. Does he still sing of conquest, we wonder? While wearing this item, you will tame your opponent's followers and summons, causing them to deal less damage to you.

items.name: Cursed Artio's Hide
items.description: Bear hide armor of Artio, bear Goddess of the Fomorian house of Nocturna. Artio, of three siblings, spent her days taming wild bears. While wearing this item, you will tame your opponent's followers and summons, causing them to deal less damage to you.

items.name: Cursed Atepomarus Mail
items.description: Heavy armor of Atepomarus, horse God and leader of the Fomorian house of Nocturna. Atepomarus, father to the three siblings, was set to ride three horses at once into battle. While wearing this item, you will tame your opponent's followers and summons, causing them to deal less damage to you.

items.name: Cursed Autumna Crested Shield
items.description: Shield of Fomor, Cursed King of Fomoria. This item grants a number of passive abilities known to be utilized by the Fomorian houses.
traits: Status Effect Chance: +21% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

items.name: Cursed Belenus's Boots
items.description: Boots worn by Belenus, healing God of the Fomorian house of Nocturna. Belenus, of three siblings, spent his days attending the sick animals of Fomoria's fields. While wearing this item, you will tame your opponent's followers and summons, causing them to deal less damage to you.

items.name: Cursed Boots
items.description: A seemingly ageless yet pristine pair of boots.

items.name: Cursed Bormana's Mantle
items.description: Light armor of Bormana, warrior water Goddess of the Fomorian house of Sumner. Bormana tended the Sumner crops with castle-sized barrels of water, a true testament to her strength. While wearing this item, skills that target multiple opponents will deal additional damage. Additionally, skills will seldomly hit more than one opponent.

items.name: Cursed Caticatona Cuirass
items.description: Large heavy armor of Caticatona, leader of the Fomorian house of Sumner. Caticatona, the armored Water Goddess, stood tall against Morrigan's acolytes, but ultimately fell by their staff and sword. While wearing this item, skills that target multiple opponents will deal additional damage. Additionally, skills will seldomly hit more than one opponent.

items.name: Cursed Caturix's Robe
items.description: Heavy, armored, robe of Caturix, war God and leader of the Fomorian house of Wintara. Caturix fought Morrigan to the bitter end, ultimately succumbing to the curse in battle. While wearing this item, buffs cast by its wearer may transfer to a party mate. Additionally, positive status effects will last longer.

items.name: Cursed Clota's Garb
items.description: Light garb of Clota, river Goddess of the Fomorian house of Autumna. Clota and her sisters traversed the riverways, tunnels, and creeks to get the edge in battle, but Morrigan's forces were far too plentiful. While wearing this item, debuffs will be easier to cast on your opponent. Additionally, it increases the maximum damage of status effects on your opponent.
traits: Status Effect Chance: +20% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

items.name: Cursed Damona's Shield
items.description: Wet shield of Damona, river Goddess of the Fomorian house of Autumna. Damona was the youngest but bravest of her sisters. While wearing this item, debuffs will be easier to cast on your opponent. Additionally, it increases the maximum damage of status effects on your opponent.
traits: Status Effect Chance: +20% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

items.name: Cursed Eostre's Circlet
items.description: Circlet of Eostre, warrior Goddess of the Fomorian house of Sumner. Eostre protected the fields and crops of Fomoria; crops that would ultimately grow the vessels of Fomoria's curse. While wearing this item, skills that target multiple opponents will deal additional damage. Additionally, skills will seldomly hit more than one opponent.

items.name: Cursed Esus's Pillar
items.description: Second staff of Esus, Stone God of the Fomorian house of Wintara. Esus constructed the mighty pillars of Fomoria, an architectural delight, truly. While wearing this item, buffs cast by its wearer may transfer to a party mate. Additionally, positive status effects will last longer.

items.name: Heart of Oceanus
items.description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Oceanus raised the great seas; crashing waves against the towers to test their might. He cooled the artifacts of Prometheus's Kiln, and forced the tower pieces into place with great tidal force.

This augment allows one to break the maximum damage limit.

items.name: Heart of Prometheus
items.description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Prometheus operated a great kiln, molding stone, steel, and ortanite needed by the Titans into great pieces of the great towers. Ultimately, it is said his synthetic flesh became a kiln in itself.

This piece increases one's resistance to status effects.

items.name: Heart of Selene
items.description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Selene had a certain way with the wildlife surrounding the towers. With the help of the birds, the trees, the hunters, and the prey -- she never felt deficient of help.

This piece will allow your follower to make more intelligent decisions in battle.

items.name: Heart of Themis
items.description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Themis, of law and order, balanced the tower planes into place with her shoulders. A plane mustn't lean down to Balor, nor up to skies. A level floor bequeaths the next level floor.

This piece allows one to recover both HP and Mana when taking Ward damage.

items.name: Arisen Aaru Sandals
items.description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

items.name: Final Decree
items.description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

This light armor improves the chances of gaining another turn via Avidity, as well as increases the damage of skills that hit multiple opponents.
